# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with sentinel value '999,999.99'
# Note: in Python, '999,999.99' as a string may not be parsed correctly due to comma
# So we'll check for the exact string
invalid_rows = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

print("Number of rows with sentinel value '999,999.99':", len(invalid_rows))
print("Channels of these rows:", invalid_rows['channel'].unique())

# Drop these rows
sales_clean = sales_df.drop(invalid_rows.index)

# Now convert revenue to numeric safely
sales_clean['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_clean['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify no missing values remain
print("After dropping sentinel rows, any missing revenue?", sales_clean['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum())"}
